optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Compliance Operations Specialist, After-Sales Service Network

professionalSummary.text: Led the development and deployment of recall‑handling procedures and compliance check definitions for a partner portal, ensuring consistent application of warranty and safety‑recall rules across the live partner network.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the recall-handling procedure and the compliance check definitions for the partner portal and tested them with three volunteer partners in the portal's sandbox tenant over two quarters, recording the outcomes per check.

professionalSummary.text: Conducted monthly compliance reviews with legal and partner management, presenting sandbox test results, addressing open questions, and logging outcomes.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the monthly compliance review with legal and partner management, presenting the sandbox test results and the open questions, and recorded the outcomes in the review log.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated rule changes with legal and partner management, maintaining a procedure change log and ensuring timely release to the live partner network.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated rule changes with legal and partner management through the procedure change log; the release of checks to the live partner network was scheduled and executed by the portal product team after legal sign-off.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each procedure release, providing clear guidance for portal team transition.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release note for the recall-handling procedure, listing the known limitation that the sandbox tenant did not include the partners' own service systems, and the hand-over items for the portal team.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed end‑to‑end compliance operations for the partner portal over approximately eighteen months, covering procedure definition, sandbox testing, monthly reviews, and change coordination.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included procedure and check definition, sandbox testing, the monthly compliance review and change coordination for the partner portal over about eighteen months.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Compliance check definitions and sandbox test outcome sheet for three volunteer partners, including sandbox tenant record identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the compliance check definitions and the sandbox test outcome sheet for the three volunteer partners, with the sandbox tenant's record identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in developing, testing, reviewing, and coordinating recall‑handling procedures and compliance checks within a partner portal, including documentation of limitations and hand‑over items. They do not provide evidence that the candidate personally executed the release to the live partner network; that responsibility was carried out by the portal product team after legal sign‑off.

decisionBoundary.statement: The evidence supports most requirements but lacks confirmation that the candidate personally deployed the procedures to the live partner network; human review is required to resolve this gap.
